parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page to display in a paged query.

parameters.name: OperationBase
parameters.description:
The asset selection dimension. Valid values:

- **0**: machine instance
- **1**: machine group
- **2**: VPC-connected instance ID

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to display per page in a paged query.
